text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 25, 2018) for 4064 Lawrence Avenue East, 221.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply (November 2, 2018) for 4064 Lawrence Avenue East, Folder No. 18 247009 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 1, 2019, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
